# Three-Pass Review

Boruch Hashem. Blessed is He.

## Pass One — Chesed: everything search needs

The ideal public page gives Google and humans the same title, description, canonical URL, H1, Torah body, Heichel context, author context, internal links, status semantics, robots policy, and sitemap discovery. JavaScript may enrich but never create the only meaningful version.

## Pass Two — Gevurah: smallest safe correction

The first correction should touch only clean files proven to own the failure: `heichelos/post/_awtsmoos.post.html`, `heichelos/post/initial-content.html`, and `heichelos/routes/heichel/readerData.js`. Do not mix robots/sitemap work into the same proof cycle. Do not touch active reader-control modules or unrelated Chitas work.

## Pass Three — Tiferes: improved exact plan

- Child template reads `post`, `heichel`, and `alias` as injected locals, guarded with `typeof` so missing content degrades safely.
- Active parent emits `postSemanticHead` when available, retaining a safe noindex fallback when semantic data is absent.
- Active parent calls child with an explicit named object, never `$$sd`.
- Direct post lookup uses series `root`, matching the newer reader coordinate contract and the actual API route surface.
- Invalid/missing post data must remain non-indexable through the semantic model.
- After rewrite, test templates through the dynamic server—not only static grep.
